title: Ponge
tagline: Icy retro pong against a bot or a friend.
description: Pong with a slippery twist: the paddles glide on ice, so every move carries momentum. Take on three AI levels or a friend on the same keyboard, switch between Arcade mode with power-ups and the Classic rules, and pick the look you like.

desktop: W / S or ↑ / ↓ — move your paddle
2 players: W / S for the left paddle, ↑ / ↓ for the right
R — restart the round, Esc — back to the menu

features: 1 or 2 players, with three AI levels (Bit Bot, Glider, Cyber Neo)
Arcade mode with Freeze, Extend and HyperSpeed power-ups
Classic mode with the original rules
Four themes: Cyber Neon, Pure Ice, Retro Atari and Synthwave
Match length of 5, 7, 10 points or endless
Your best rally is saved on your device

title: Poke
tagline: Dodge the dogs and survive as long as you can.
description: Steer a tiny hamster through a yard full of running dogs. You score a point for every second you survive, and the dogs spawn faster the longer you last. One touch and it's over.

desktop: Move the mouse — the hamster follows it, no click needed
Arrow keys or WASD also work
mobile: Drag anywhere on the screen — the hamster moves relative to your finger

features: Score is the number of seconds you survive
Difficulty ramps up as your score grows
Soft, colour-shifting background lights
Your best score is saved on your device
Fullscreen and mute buttons

title: Change Balls
tagline: Match the colours and keep the rhythm.
description: A ball bounces between two rotating pillars. Flip them at just the right moment so the ball meets the matching colour. The speed ramps up every 10 points, hearts keep you in the game, and a split-screen mode lets two players compete on one device.

desktop: Click, Space or Enter — flip the pillars
2 players: Space or A for the left player, Enter or D for the right
mobile: Tap anywhere to flip the pillars
2 players: tap the left or right half of the screen

features: 1 or 2 players on the same device
Speed increases every 10 points
An extra heart every 40 points and 20-hit combo streaks
Adjustable ball speed in the settings
Separate best scores for each mode, plus a statistics screen
Original music and sound effects

title: Flappy Bird
tagline: Tap to flap. Don't touch the pipes.
description: The classic one-button challenge, rebuilt for the web. Fly through the gaps, earn medals from bronze to platinum, and switch between three skins: the classic bird, a cyber car or an alien UFO.

desktop: Click the bird on the start screen to change skin
mobile: Tap the bird on the start screen to change skin

features: Medals at 10, 20, 30 and 40 points
Three skins: Classic Bird, Cyber Car and Alien UFO
Particle effects and retro sound
Your best score and skin are saved on your device
Portrait layout that fits any screen

title: Hit The Coin
description: Click the spinning coin as many times as you can before the timer runs out. Special coins are worth double and add a second to the clock, and quick hits in a row build up combos.
features: 15-second rounds
Special coins are worth 2 points and add 1 second
Combo bonus for hits within 1.5 seconds of each other
Urgent ticking in the final 3 seconds
Your best score is saved on your device

title: Vega
description: Hidden until it is remade for the new engine. The old build is still served at /vega/.
features: Legacy Godot build
